segmented-control.name: Segmented Control
segmented-control.purpose: Switch one mutually exclusive local mode inside the current surface without navigating, filtering a dashboard, or coordinating a process.

anatomy.rule: Groups related exclusive options and owns the shared border.
One selectable mode with visible label.
Shows the active mode through Flow action-primary, outline contrast, low radius, and aria-selected.
Marks keyboard focus on the active segment.

variants.description: Low-radius outlined mode switch for local exclusive choices, visually distinct from Tabs.
Tool-adjacent switch for dense work areas.
Icon-only mode switch with accessible labels for compact local choices.

segmented-control.statePrecedence: disabled > warning > selected > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use Flow action-primary for selected/current segment; ZIP informs shape, outline treatment, and motion.
Energy.behavior: The component communicates action and priority without raw colors.
Energy.test: Verify selected/current segment uses Flow action-primary and nonselected segments use neutral text/surface.
Energy.rejectIf: Selected/current uses raw color or non-Flow color.

Voice.decision: Use concise labels and short contextual copy.
Voice.behavior: Text explains the local decision without pattern instructions.

Frame.decision: Use stable geometry, spacing, and target size.

Depth.decision: Use elevation only when the component floats above a surface.
Depth.behavior: Layering clarifies context without persistent workspace behavior.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System motion for state and layer transitions.
Momentum.behavior: Changes feel responsive and respect reduced motion.

State.decision: Use explicit state precedence from the contract.
State.example: disabled > warning > selected > focus > hover > default

Tone.decision: Use warning or critical tone only with visible reason.
Tone.behavior: Risk is explained through copy and state.

Growth.decision: Escalate orchestration beyond one local control to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols as support for visible labels or accessible names.
Symbol.behavior: Icons accelerate recognition without replacing meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and optical alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Symbols align with text and target size.

Accessibility.decision: Expose label, state, focus, keyboard, and dismissal or selection behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive technology can operate the component.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ key?: string; value?: string; label: string; icon?: string }>
props.notes: Visible segments with stable keys, optional values, and optional supporting icons.

props.name: selectedKey
props.notes: Currently selected item key or value.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Presentation variant for the local segmented surface.

props.name: density
props.notes: Density-owned scale for segment target sizing.

do: Use for one local mutually exclusive choice.
Keep labels visible even when icons are present.
Keep the selected item announced with aria-selected.
dont: Do not use for page navigation.
Do not combine unrelated controls inside the group.
Do not use it as a dashboard filter bar.
info: Check mobile wrapping and label fit.
Check selected contrast in every density.

tests: Outlined, toolbar, compact, and icon-only variants have package-backed geometry
agentInstructions: Use Segmented Control for view mode, chart mode, local layout density, or map/list switch.
Keep each segment as a single option with visible text.
Use warning only when the current mode has a policy or availability caveat.
rejectIf: Toolbar or compact is only documented but not implemented in package styles.

semanticDecisions.decision: Use sys.energy action-primary for selected/current segment.
semanticDecisions.zipInfluence: Low-radius outline, compact geometry, icon support, and indicator motion.
